followups.purpose: Handle CMake include-directory results returned as either strings or arrays, and escape spaces in exported include flags.
Keep external include flags behind PostgreSQL headers, serialize extra_include_dirs paths with spaces safely for PGXS, and pass the same include arguments to fallback header probes.

verification.native_builds: GitHub-hosted Windows x64 and ARM64 only
verification.scope: Controlled CMake/pkg-config and extra_include_dirs include-export cases, focused Meson fallback header-argument controls, and actual psql header-order canary builds. No full server, installed extension, provider, full optional-dependency configuration, or PGXS runtime claim.
